args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Covey & Lark Retail was renamed Pellow Home Living (PHL) on 16 Feb.
- Filtering "PHL" in the morning report now returns two different businesses: Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics. The Coastal team raised this on 17 Feb.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows; the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing.
- On 17 Feb the team said the saved retail view would be relabelled with the full name. The digest suggests that may not have covered this report.

Could you help get the saved report(s) relabelled and the PHL filter made unambiguous?

Thanks,
Bettina
